title: Michigan Senate Candidates Clash Over Trump Tariffs and Iran War in Midterm Debate
detail: Michigan Senate candidates Abdul El-Sayed and Mike Rogers sparred in a debate over Trump's tariff regime, the ongoing US-Iran conflict, and healthcare access, reflecting broader national fault lines ahead of the November midterms. The exchange highlighted deepening partisan divisions over the administration's economic and foreign policy record.

title: Trump Tariff Regime Raises Costs for US Biotech Firms Relying on Imported Pharmaceutical Inputs
detail: US biotech companies are reporting increased costs due to Trump's tariff regime, which has raised prices on imported pharmaceutical inputs and raw materials. The new tariff framework is forcing firms to reassess supply chains, with industry groups warning of downstream effects on drug development timelines and consumer prices.

title: Trump Awards Elon Musk Presidential Scientific Medal, Marking Formal Return to Favor
detail: President Trump presented Elon Musk with a presidential scientific medal at the White House, signaling Musk's formal return to favor after a period of reported tension between the two. The ceremony marks a visible reconciliation following months of friction over DOGE spending cuts and public disagreements, with Musk once again positioned as a prominent ally of the administration.

title: India's TCS Says US Green Card Programme Suspension Will Not Affect Workforce or Hiring
detail: Indian IT giant Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) stated that the Trump administration's suspension of the US green card programme will have no material impact on its workforce composition or hiring strategy. The statement reflects a broader adaptation by major Indian outsourcing firms to the tightened US immigration environment under Trump's second term.

title: US Senators Demand Answers on Trump Accepting Gold Diamond Ring as Alleged Quid Pro Quo for Tariff Reduction
detail: US senators launched an inquiry demanding answers on whether President Trump accepted an 18-karat gold diamond ring — containing 321 diamonds and 75 gemstones — as a quid pro quo in exchange for reducing tariffs on diamonds. The allegation raises fresh corruption and ethics concerns as lawmakers pressed for disclosure of any gift-related communications and whether trade policy was shaped by personal inducements.

title: Trump Immigration Crackdown Could Cut Social Security Benefits by Up to $2,000 Annually, Analysis Finds
detail: A new analysis found that Trump's mass immigration enforcement push could reduce annual Social Security benefits for Americans by up to $2,000 by shrinking the payroll tax base. Fewer immigrant workers means fewer payroll tax contributors, analysts warned, potentially accelerating the timeline for Social Security insolvency and reducing per-beneficiary payouts for current and future retirees.
